meta.scope: Philippines Batch 6 — Education (higher education), health (PhilHealth + key indicators), and Mindanao / BARMM regional densification.

candidates.title: Higher education statistics (enrolment, institutions, graduates)
candidates.publisher: Commission on Higher Education (CHED) / PSA related
candidates.description: Official statistics on higher-education institutions, enrolment, graduates and faculty. Provides the human-capital supply side that feeds both the domestic labour market and the OFW / IT-BPM talent pipelines.
referenced_by: Labor Force Survey and skills analysis

candidates.title: Basic education statistics (DepEd)
candidates.description: Enrolment, completion and related indicators for elementary and secondary education. Complements the higher-education series and links to 4Ps education conditions.

candidates.title: PhilHealth coverage and claims statistics
candidates.description: Membership, coverage, claims and financial performance statistics of the national health-insurance programme. Central instrument of health financing and universal-health-coverage policy.

candidates.title: Key health and nutrition indicators
candidates.description: Official indicators on child nutrition (stunting, wasting, underweight), vaccination, maternal care, mortality and leading causes of death. Provides the outcome side of the health system.

candidates.title: BARMM (Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao) economic and statistical profile
candidates.description: Regional accounts, growth and sectoral performance for the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region. Captures the distinctive political-economy and development trajectory of the autonomous region within Mindanao.
candidates.notes: Key autonomous-region node. Distinct institutional and development path inside the Philippine archipelago.

candidates.title: Mindanao regional economic profile
candidates.publisher: Derived from PSA GRDP and related regional series
candidates.description: System-level view of Mindanao’s economic structure — agriculture-heavy in many areas, with distinct growth patterns, resource endowments and the special case of BARMM. Complements the Luzon-core concentration nodes.

candidates.title: Philippines education–health–Mindanao densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from CHED, DepEd, PhilHealth, PSA and BARMM sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding higher-education statistics, basic-education indicators, PhilHealth coverage, key health/nutrition outcomes, BARMM economic profile and broader Mindanao regional structure into a coherent human-capital and southern-spatial layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier 4Ps, labour, regional and poverty series
